General Requirements

Except for HES 100, only courses of 3 or more semester hours count towards satisfying basic and divisional requirements.

  1. the core requirements, and
  2. elective courses, for a total of 120 credit hours.

Basic Requirements

  • FYS 100 (first-year seminar) - to be taken during first year
  • 4 writing credits to be fulfilled by either: WRI 109 (2 h) and WRI 110 (2 h), or WRI 111 (4 h). Should be taken during the first year
  • One 200-level foreign language course
  • HES 100
